name: CAIO Implementation Runbook
description: Phase 2 (BUILD) of the Chief-AI-Officer accompaniment chain. Takes caio-enterprise-workflow-architect's company-ai-os/ blueprint and REALIZES it into the offer's centralized federated topology (one dedicated client-owned server + one function-specific micro-SaaS per C-Level: CIO/CTO, CMO, CFO, CDO, COO, CHRO, CSO) behind a gated Architecture-Realization spec, then BUILDS it: server provisioning (5.1), per-C-Level micro-SaaS build checklist, the inter-dashboard API contract so a COO metric triggers a CFO alert (5.3, the differentiator), Composio wiring with the 6-critical-connectors rule (5.4), automated reports (5.5), monitoring + North-Star/cost/usage instrumentation baseline at t0 (5.8, mm-11), and a per-deliverable ship-gate that delivers value in week 1. Anti-black-box: every dashboard exposes sources, logs, status, errors, costs, confidence. Stack: Next.js + Convex + Clerk + Stripe + Composio + Claude Code SDK (each justified). Delegates per-agent builds to agentic-systems-builder and repeatable-skill codification to agentik-skill-forge. Keeps the sponsor bought-in via milestone demos and progress briefs (mm-04). Hands the live system + internal docs to caio-enablement-and-transfer.
author: Agentik OS
